notes:
CHAT AND SOCIAL

In-game chat now opens as a fixed communications drawer instead of a floating bubble. Switch between Match Chat, Messages, Friends, and Requests without leaving the match, while only one communications surface is open at a time.

LAYOUT POLISH

The main-menu Social launcher is locked in the upper-right. Profile images, player names, status text, tabs, borders, and scroll rows now use consistent spacing and remain inside their panels at supported window sizes.

NOTIFICATIONS

Collapsed Social continues to show unread messages, friend requests, and pending lobby invitations. Invitations remain queued and unavailable for acceptance until the active match ends.
